Agent Name: Statistics_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: They chose to scrape the live Wikipedia page instead of the required historical snapshot (as of 2021-01-01) and did not constrain the value to the 2020 estimate, misusing the data source (Rule 2). - From_agent: Statistics_Expert

  agent_strength: 0.70

      if_from_agent_wrong: Stats may pass along an unrounded or misattributed figure.
